verdict.line: You lose if you walk into her Hallowed Mist or trade face-to-face in her Q cone; you win if you punish a whiffed Skip 'n Slash or land a clean R.

brief.thesis: Gwen's entire kit is built around safe poke and cooldown cycling: Q (Snip Snip!) recharges in as little as 3.5s at max rank and W (Hallowed Mist) makes her untouchable the moment she retreats into it, since only champions who step inside the mist can target or be targeted by her. Malphite has no ranged way to force damage through that mist, so the lane is decided by who controls when the fight actually happens. That's why the measured numbers sit close to even (47.9% Malphite win rate over 1462 games, solo-kill rate even) rather than genuinely lopsided.

theirWindow.when: Right after her E dash connects
theirWindow.what: She gains Attack Speed, range, and magic on-hit for a few seconds and her A Thousand Cuts passive starts stacking fast heals off every hit. Back off and let the buff expire instead of trading autos with her here.

yourWindow.what: The dash only refunds cooldown if it hits something, so a miss leaves her locked out of E for its full 11-13s cooldown. Step in immediately with Q, autos, and W's cleave while she has no gap-closer or escape.

start.item: Doran's Ring + Health Potion + Health Potion
start.why: the dominant start on this matchup (76.9% pick, 48.7% win rate over 1358 games) — the regen and mana sustain let you match her poke cadence instead of running out of resources first.

boots.why: Gwen's damage is almost entirely magic (passive on-hit, Q, R), so the magic resist and tenacity (47.8% win rate, 46.9% pick) outvalue Plated Steelcaps here.

core.why: the highest measured line through this item (71.9% win rate, 32 games) front-loads CDR and burst so your Q-E-R combo comes back faster

runes.keystoneWhy: procs off your Q (Seismic Shard) landing at 625 range, adding chip damage without ever stepping into her 450-range Q cone.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is the measured highest win rate line on this matchup (50.6% over 24.3% pick), and with solo-kills listed as even, Ignite's sustained damage converts close skirmishes into kills while cutting her A Thousand Cuts healing.

playing.title: Punish a whiffed E
playing.detail: Skip 'n Slash only refunds its cooldown if it hits something. The moment you see her dash miss, she's locked out of E for 11-13s — step in with Q and autos right away.

playing.title: Never walk into her Mist
playing.detail: Once she casts W (Hallowed Mist), only champions who enter the mist can target or be targeted by her. Stand outside at your Q's 625 range and let its 18-22s cooldown run rather than diving in for a trade you can't finish.

playing.title: Poke before she cones you
playing.detail: Lead with Q (Seismic Shard, 8s cooldown) at max range. Getting tagged by her Q cone resets how quickly your Granite Shield passive recharges, so stay out of her 450-range cone when you're not committing.

playing.title: Slam her on-hit window
playing.detail: Fire E (Ground Slam) the moment she commits to an on-hit trade — the attack speed reduction cuts how many hits her A Thousand Cuts passive lands, and less heal-back.

playing.title: Save R for a clean knockup
playing.detail: Unstoppable Force is 130s at rank 1 and only drops to 80s at rank 3. Don't throw it to catch a wave — hold it until you can follow the knockup with W's cleave and E's shockwave.

playing.title: Rush anti-heal if she snowballs
playing.detail: If her passive sustain is winning extended trades, prioritize Thornmail or Bramble Vest earlier than the standard build order.

playing.title: Pop W only on commit
playing.detail: Brutal Strikes' Armor/AD buff is short-lived. Activate it right before you commit to a fight, not while clearing waves or walking up.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/pick-rate numbers above come from measured games on the current patch (16.19.1); the tactical reading of how and why those numbers happen is my own.
